Operations.Name: IscsiInitiatorCreate
Operations.Description:
Create an iSCSI Initiator.

`initiators` is a list of initiator hostnames which are authorized to access an iSCSI Target. To allow all
possible initiators, `initiators` can be left empty.

Arguments.Name: iscsi_initiator_create
Arguments.Description: Authorized initiator group configuration data for creation.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the authorized initiator group to delete.
